summary: Section F provides instructions for reporting reason codes for residential-risk cancellation, nonrenewal, and declination notices. It defines usage guidance for cancellation and nonrenewal/declination reason codes, requires a reason-source indicator when decisions rely on aerial imagery or other third-party information, and maps Section C premium/loss record codes to Section E type-of-policy codes for reason-code reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks — Section F
proposed_nodes.title: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks (eff. 2026-01-01), Section F: Additional Instructions for Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices

proposed_nodes.name: TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks 2026 Edition
Rule Section F — Additional Instructions for Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices
proposed_nodes.title: Additional Instructions for Cancellation, Nonrenewal, and Declination Notices

proposed_nodes.name: Reason Source Indicator Field
proposed_nodes.notes: Used to note, as appropriate, when cancellation, nonrenewal, or declination relied in whole or part on aerial imagery or other third-party information; connected to Insurance Code §551.002 source-disclosure requirement.

proposed_nodes.name: Cancellation Reasons Code List
proposed_nodes.description: Reason codes and usage instructions for cancellation notices.

proposed_nodes.name: Cancellation Reason 1 — Increase in Hazard
proposed_nodes.notes: Use when the policy was canceled due to an insured-controlled increase in hazard that would have increased the premium rate, or when the policy had been in effect less than 60 days and the insurer identifies an undisclosed increased-risk condition not the subject of a prior claim.

proposed_nodes.name: Cancellation Reason 2 — No Inspection Report Accepted
proposed_nodes.notes: Use if before the policy effective date the insurer does not accept a required inspection report copy completed by an inspector and dated within 90 days of the effective date.

proposed_nodes.name: Cancellation Reason 3 — Insured’s Request
proposed_nodes.notes: Use for cancellation by the insured’s representative due to the insured’s death, when the insured no longer has an insurable interest in the property, or for any other reason if cancellation was at the insured’s request.

proposed_nodes.name: Cancellation Reason 4 — Other, Insurer’s Action
proposed_nodes.notes: Use when the insured submitted a fraudulent claim, TDI determined continuation would violate law, or the reason is not otherwise listed under cancellation reason codes.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal and Declination Reasons Code List
proposed_nodes.description: Reason codes and usage instructions for nonrenewal and declination notices.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal/Declination Reason 1 — Exposure to Loss: Liability
proposed_nodes.notes: Use when the action is due to exposure to the insured’s personal liability risk.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal/Declination Reason 2 — Exposure to Loss: Insurer’s Concentration of Risk
proposed_nodes.description: Exposure to loss – insurer’s concentration of risk
proposed_nodes.notes: Use when the insurer is not writing new business or renewing policies because of excessive exposure in a particular area or subline; do not use if the reason is wildfire or wind/hail/hurricane exposure.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal/Declination Reason 3 — Insurer Withdrawing from the Market
proposed_nodes.notes: Use when the insurer has filed a withdrawal plan with TDI that has been approved; do not use any other reason codes with this one.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal/Declination Reason 4 — Location of Risk
proposed_nodes.notes: Use if the insurer does not write in certain areas and none of the exposure-to-loss reasons apply.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal/Declination Reason 5 — Credit or Insurance Score
proposed_nodes.notes: Use if the policy was nonrenewed or declined because of the insured's credit score; because credit alone cannot be the sole basis without other underwriting factors, another reason must also be reported when this reason is used.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal/Declination Reason 6 — Condition of Property
proposed_nodes.notes: Use all applicable reason codes related to property condition when the action type is due to condition of property; if due to not writing particular roof types, code as Other, insurer’s action rather than Condition of property.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal/Declination Reason 7 — Value of Home
proposed_nodes.notes: Use when the property exceeds the limit set in the insurer’s underwriting guidelines.

proposed_nodes.name: Nonrenewal/Declination Reason 8 — Other, Insurer’s Action
proposed_nodes.notes: Use if no other specific reason codes apply; includes failure to pay membership dues required by the insurer as a condition for coverage.
